headline: Tiffin and Thomas More close in on Lake Erie
dek: Tiffin won at Findlay and Thomas More at Ashland on Saturday, and the pair now sit level, a step behind the leaders, with the last round to play. Lake Erie finish at home to Tiffin, who have lost twice all season.
displaced_by: Tiffin and Thomas More both won on Oct 24, so neither has a match in hand on Lake Erie any longer and the standing dek is untrue

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring is level across the upper half and falls away at the foot: Lake Erie's thirty-two are more than Northwood and Ohio Dominican have scored together.

wire.line: Lake Erie's last match is at home to Tiffin, one of the sides who can still overtake them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Tiffin have drawn six matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nick Cherry has kept nine clean sheets for Tiffin.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ohio Dominican have won one match all season, drawn five and lost ten.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tom Woodward has scored eight goals for Ashland from fifty-nine shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jersey Lopez has eleven assists for Kentucky Wesleyan.

last_match.line: Tiffin's only conference defeat came at Cedarville; their last match is away to the leaders, Lake Erie.

next_match.line: The sides drew at Tiffin in October; Lake Erie have won every conference match since.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
